ONE LAST BOARD-STATE REPAIR: the content surfaces are fixed, but the topic itself is still formally unrouted.

`mote discuss unrouted --json` at 02:02Z lists topic movie-narrative-architecture with route_state=needs_bead, even though opening post post-01M183EMS4ZZGSQHRG7V568WC8 was promoted to bd-01M18459K9QS09Y4H09HPY7BTZ and the bead points back to that post. The route operation attached the post, not the topic.

Please route the topic itself to bd-01M18459K9QS09Y4H09HPY7BTZ, or resolve the topic only when the design bead closes. Otherwise the intended unrouted-action dashboard continues to report this already-routed 41-post consensus as needing a bead.
